messages:
Jun Park: Heads up — since ~05:12 UTC we're seeing repeated GPU node crashes in ap-southeast-1 (aps1). ~6 nodes flaked in the last 20m, most after a sudden power drop. Observed immediate -50% available GPU capacity on the serving pool.
OpsBot: alert: gpu-node-monitor detected 6x node resets (gpu-aps1-11, gpu-aps1-12, gpu-aps1-14, gpu-aps1-18, gpu-aps1-19, gpu-aps1-22). Recent syslog: 'PSU fault, AC loss, PM: hard reset'
Maya Singh: Ack. Can you confirm if these are all in rack r23? Any ECC logs or just power resets?
Jun Park: Mostly power resets. No ECC stack traces. Quick grep from node-12: `kernel: power_supply: PSU1 FAULT at 0x3b` and `nvlink: reset due to voltage_drop`. Rack map: r23 (gpu-aps1-11/12/14), r24 (18/19), r26 (22).
Ravi Patel: Short-term: we should shift traffic off aps1 to eu-west for low-latency tolerant routes and keep pinned customers on dedicated capacity only if they opted into cross-region. Can someone run canary reroute?
Eli Torres: Starting canary reroute now — moving 10% of general inference traffic to eu-west pool via `route-policy --region-fallback eu-west --percent 10 --tag general`. Will monitor latency and error rate.
Maya Singh: FYI cross-region will spike egress costs. Estimate: ~$1200/day per 10% at current qps. Tag billing to infra-outage-aps1.
Platform Oncall: Deploy plan: cordon affected nodes, drain tasks with `kubectl cordon/drain` and fallback to warm standby. Who's owning physicals?
Jun Park: I'm coordinating replacement. Suspect failing PSUs across multiple PSUs in same manufacturing batch. I've collected serials: GPU-APS1-11:SNL-AX392, 12:SNL-AX393, 14:SNL-AX395, 18:SNL-AX412, 19:SNL-AX413, 22:SNL-AX421. Opening RMA with vendor now.
SRE-Bot: `kubectl drain gpu-aps1-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` -> pod eviction ok. Repeat for listed nodes.
Eli Torres: Confirmed canary: latency +12ms, error rate +0.2% — within guardrails. Increasing fallback to 30% while we throttle new tokens and limit batch sizes. Executing: `route-policy update --percent 30`
Maya Singh: Approve emergency budget for cross-region traffic up to $6k/day if needed. Please add cost center tag and set alerts for >$3k/day.
Jun Park: Vendor RMA opened, case #RMA-99342. Vendor confirms spare PSUs available in regional depot, ETA on-site 18 hours. Onsite tech: TechSwap (contract). I'll schedule physical swap for night window to avoid more churn.
Ravi Patel: Good. In parallel, can we spin up temporary on-demand GPU nodes in ap-northeast-1 to reduce eu-west egress? Might be cheaper than sustained cross-region for the next 24-48h.
Eli Torres: Provisioning 8 on-demand k80-equivalent nodes in ap-northeast-1 now. Will report cost and capacity.
Jun Park: Added runbook pointer: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/power-failure-psu — following steps 3-7 for pre-swap diagnostics. Please attach serial photos after swap.
Platform Oncall: Logging maintenance window tentative: 23:30–00:30 UTC tonight for PSU swap on r23/r24/r26. Marking as possible transient service impact.
Maya Singh: Also note: customers on Dedicated with pinned hardware should NOT be auto-failed — keep them isolated. Notify Account Ops for any SLA exposures.
Jun Park: Will notify Account Ops and support. I'll post updates here after swap completes or if vendor ETA changes. :white_check_mark:
Eli Torres: Update: ap-northeast-1 nodes up, adding to routing pool. Estimated peak cost for the extra capacity ~ $800/day.
OpsBot: alert resolved: immediate node instability reduced after canary shift to 30% and extra capacity added. Monitoring continues.
Jun Park: Vendor confirmed pickup tomorrow AM if swap unsuccessful; spare PSUs will be installed tonight. Thanks everyone.
Maya Singh: Thx — keep billing tags and escalation if costs > $4k/day.
Ravi Patel: I'll follow up on post-mortem and defect to avoid single-batch PSU susceptibility. Assigning to hw-reliability.
Jun Park: End of thread for now. Will reopen if status changes.
